messages:
luis: FYI - AcmeRetail RFI dropped into our inbox. They want a POC, full RFP answers, license language, and KMS/HSM specifics. Uploaded PDF: https://drive.google.com/open?id=acme_rfi_1768882345. Can we assemble a publishable response by tomorrow?
sarah.p: Reading. Q12 asks about customer-managed keys and whether we support external HSMs for Hosted — we do not for Hosted, right?
anya: Product: Correct, Hosted = platform-managed keys only (envelope encryption). Dedicated supports customer KMS via cloud provider integrations. Private can integrate with on-prem HSM appliances or BYO cloud HSM. I'll draft a capability matrix snippet.
omar: Legal: I'll prepare license carveouts around data processing and certification requests. If they insist on HSM for Hosted, we'll need to scope a Private deployment or a new offering.
david: Ops/POC: I can run the POC infra. Propose timeline: week 0 (kickoff & access), week 1 (functional validation), week 2 (load/throughput), week 3 (final tuning & acceptance). Need sample dataset (anonymized), target throughput (QPS), latency SLO, and acceptance tests.
luis: Good. Sarah, can you pull a pricing sketch (per-token vs reserved) and call out any incremental costs for Private/HSM?
sarah.p: Will do. Note: Private pricing includes on-prem installation and a one-time integration fee for HSM attestation. I'll include a short table in the RFI response.
anya: Capability matrix draft (pasteable):

"Mode | Customer KMS/HSM | Data Residency | SLA | Notes"
"Hosted | Platform-managed keys (no customer HSM) | Regional | 99.9% | Envelope encryption; customers cannot upload root keys"
"Dedicated | Cloud KMS integration (customer-managed) | VPC/Region | 99.95% | Support for BYOK via cloud KMS; no physical HSM attestation"
"Private | On-prem/cloud HSM supported | On-prem/VPC | Negotiable | FIPS-validated HSMs supported; attestation & on-site validation can be arranged"

omar: Here's a concise HSM blurb for the questionnaire: "Redwood supports customer-managed key custody in Dedicated and Private deployments. For Hosted customers we use platform-managed keys with envelope encryption. Private deployments may be configured to use FIPS-validated HSM appliances or cloud HSM providers; Redwood will collaborate on attestation and integration requirements during onboarding."
luis: Nice. David - can you confirm estimated GPU footprint for an internal load test (target 200 QPS, 200-token avg response)?
david: For 200 QPS at 200 tokens avg we should provision 8 A100-equivalent GPUs for the baseline load test (with autoscale headroom). I'll include scaling docs and runbook.
sarah.p: Pricing note to include: Reserved Dedicated pools reduce unit cost by ~30% vs on-demand; Private has a setup/validation fee (TBD) plus monthly support. I'll attach an initial price sheet to the RFI doc.
luis: Action items: Omar - license language and HSM blurb by EOD. Sarah - pricing table + attachment. Anya - finalize capability matrix and quantization caveat (int8 benefits and possible edge-case delta). David - infra plan & runbook. I'll assemble and send to Acme after final review at 16:45.
kevin.salesbot: Uploaded file: /drive/rfi/acme_rfi_1768882345_v1.pdf
luis: Sent to Acme at 17:03. Replied to include request: please confirm POC dataset availability and whether they need NDA addendum for security testing. Will follow up here when they reply. :thumbsup:
